title: subscribe_events: no doc on caller responsibility for reconnect / Last-Event-ID tracking
description: client.rs subscribe_events: The function doc mentions 'If last_event_id is Some, sends a Last-Event-ID header' but does not explain that the caller must track SseFrame::id across stream iterations and pass it back on reconnect. A caller who ignores SseFrame::id and passes None on every reconnect will silently miss events. This is not obvious from the signature. The doc should explicitly state: 'Callers must track the last non-None SseFrame::id and pass it back to subscribe_events on reconnect to avoid missing push events.'
